The fine-tuning process retained representations established during pre-training, continuing to leverage the concatenated features from Galactica and Sentence-BERT that yield 4864-dimensional node features.

ScRNA-seq data were obtained from 27 primary AML specimens, as previously described by Pei et al. 42 . The dataset comprised 32,416 high-quality single-cell transcriptomes, representing 14 distinct cell populations across the myeloid differentiation hierarchy.
